title: Vercel ignores the dashboard Build Command, Output Directory, and Node settings because vercel.json has builds
symptoms: Build log warns that Build and Development Settings from Project Settings will not apply because builds exists
Changing the Build Command in the dashboard has no effect
Adding a functions block fails with a conflicting functions and builds configuration error
cause: A legacy builds array switches the project out of zero configuration mode, so the dashboard build settings are skipped and only build outputs are deployed. builds and functions cannot be combined.
fix: Delete the builds array, move memory and maxDuration settings into functions, and replace legacy routes with rewrites, redirects, or headers.
affected: Any Vercel project whose vercel.json still has builds, as of October 2026
